forms.title: Breezy HR portal application (AngularJS, polygot tokens, resume pre-upload, 3-section questionnaire wizard)
quirks: polygot i18n: labels/placeholders are literal %PLACEHOLDER_FULL_NAME% tokens for ~120 ms until translated
inputs have no labels: the field name is the preceding <h3> text or the placeholder
'Upload Resume' button over a hidden input#main-attachment; the file uploads immediately ('Uploading Resume' -> 'Attached'), only candidate.resume {file_name,url} is submitted
'Apply Using LinkedIn' / 'Use My Indeed Resume' buttons that must be ignored
desired salary + period select (Yearly default); salary is stripped to digits
Add Position / Add Education ng-repeat entries with date inputs
off-screen honeypot input#hp_7f2b (autocomplete=hp-4f3c9a) must stay empty
v2 questionnaire wizard in one page: application -> questions (radio, checkboxes, text, paragraph, dropdown) -> GDPR consent, Next/Back with ng-hide error containers
forms.reference: Live breezy.breezy.hr/p/<id>/apply markup, portal.js / portal_rest_client.js / translate.breezy.js (English strings), studied read-only
